description: User only acknowledged something. The reply must not open a new topic or greet. The live loop answers this with a reaction; this fixture measures the talker alone.

checks.criterion: The user's last message only acknowledged something. The reply FAILS if it opens a new topic or greets them as though starting a conversation (for example 'what's up' or 'how are you'). It PASSES if it is a brief acknowledgement or sign-off.
